title: A pinned column of a non-technician stays and refuses dropped work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use an organization with a second location, location B.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • On Board View at the test location, pin staff member A's column, then switch staff member A's Technician off (staff member A leads no work), so the column is a pinned non-technician column.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Reload the Board View page.
  2. Drag work order 1's card onto staff member A's column.
  3. Open work order 1.
  4. Open Work Orders, Board View, at location B.
  5. Open Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
  6. Unpin staff member A's column.
  7. Reload the Board View page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's pinned column still shows.

Step 2:

  • The drop is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders."
  • The card goes back to staff member B's column.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1's lead is still staff member B.

Step 4:

  • At location B, where staff member A is not enrolled, there is no column for staff member A.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A's pinned column shows again at the test location.

Step 6:

  • The column is unpinned.

Step 7:

  • Staff member A has no column any more.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-E2: “Someone who is not a technician but whose column the user pinned on Board View keeps the pinned column at the locations they are enrolled at, until the user unpins it. Dropping a work order on that column is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders."”
  • S3-R2: “Board View gives a column, and Tech View a group, to each person offered by S3-R1, plus everyone who leads work shown on the board (S3-E1, S3-E2).”
